# BuTools Library

This is a Python port of the BuTools library originally implemented in MATLAB
and located at `matlab/lib/thirdparty/BUTools/` in the LINE solver repository.

BuTools is a comprehensive library for the analysis and fitting of:

- **Phase-type (PH) distributions** and discrete PH distributions
- **Matrix-exponential (ME) distributions**
- **Markovian Arrival Processes (MAP)** and discrete MAPs (DMAP)
- **Markov chains** (continuous and discrete time)
- **Moments** computation and matching
- **Queueing models** with matrix-analytic methods
- **Trace fitting** and representation transformations

## Origin

This code is a derivative work ported from MATLAB to Python for use in the
native Python implementation of the LINE solver. The original MATLAB source
is located at `matlab/lib/thirdparty/BUTools/` in the LINE solver repository.
